idea-plugin.name: Excalidraw Editor
idea-plugin.description:
Open and edit .excalidraw drawings directly inside JetBrains IDEs.

Excalidraw Editor adds a full embedded Excalidraw canvas to IntelliJ IDEA, WebStorm, PyCharm, GoLand, and other compatible JetBrains IDEs. Drawings remain ordinary .excalidraw JSON files in your project, ready to commit, review, and share with the rest of your codebase.

Features

  • Open and edit .excalidraw files in a dedicated editor tab.
  • Create new Excalidraw drawings and scratch files directly from the IDE.
  • Use the familiar Excalidraw drawing tools without leaving the IDE.
  • Load drawings created by Excalidraw and other compatible editors.
  • Automatically sync canvas changes into the IDE document.
  • Save through the IDE using Save, Save All, and normal IDE save behaviour.
  • Remember the last manually selected Excalidraw theme for new drawings.
  • Keep drawings local and version-control friendly.
  • Run the bundled editor without requiring a cloud account.

Compatibility note

Only one installed plugin should register the .excalidraw file type. Disable or uninstall other Excalidraw editor plugins before enabling this plugin to avoid file-type and editor conflicts.

Free and open source. This is an unofficial community plugin and is not endorsed by or affiliated with Excalidraw.
idea-plugin.change-notes:
0.2.11 - 2026-08-21

  • Improved macOS trackpad panning with responsive, frame-coalesced scrolling that follows the system scroll-direction preference.
  • Added native macOS pinch-to-zoom support with cursor-anchored Excalidraw zooming.
  • Improved scrolling in Excalidraw menus and other scrollable controls without changing normal mouse-wheel behaviour.
  • Requested non-OSR JCEF presentation when supported, with an automatic compatibility fallback for IDEs that require off-screen rendering.
  • Matched OSR rendering to the active display refresh rate and added editor settings for the refresh-rate, pinch, and trackpad adapters.
